title: ERC-4337 Non-Custodial Account Key Rotation & Disaster Recovery Specification
description: Cryptographically authenticated migration manifest transferring signer authorization over an ERC-4337 Smart Contract Account between physical silicon roots of trust (AER Appendix C.3). Supports cooperative dual-attestation key rotation with TPM zeroization proof, alongside multi-party quorum disaster recovery under hardware destruction.

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning string of this formal schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

account_id.description: ERC-4337 smart contract account address anchoring persistent state, balance, and operational history.

migration_type.description: Key rotation procedure: GRACEFUL_HANDOVER (bilateral cryptographic handshake with key zeroization) or EMERGENCY_DISASTER_RECOVERY (multi-party guild quorum following physical hardware failure).

old_node_id.description: EVM operational address of the decommissioned or failed hardware node.

new_node_id.description: EVM operational address of the target hardware node assuming signer delegation.

blinded_silicon_commitment.description: Pedersen commitment Commit(Chip_Secret, r) verifying target silicon integrity.

platform_pcr_digest.description: Platform Configuration Register measurement digest for target secure boot state.

ak_quote.description: Hardware quote payload signed by target TPM Attestation Key.

new_tpm_attestation.description: Complete hardware attestation evidence structure verifying the target silicon root of trust.

zeroization_type.description: Hardware command standard executing irrevocable key destruction.

proof_signature.description: Cryptographic signature or hardware receipt attesting that previous signing keys have been zeroized.

zeroization_proof.description: Cryptographic evidence verifying that obsolete signing credentials have been permanently cleared within the retiring silicon (mandatory for GRACEFUL_HANDOVER).

old_node_signature.description: ECDSA signature from the retiring node authorizing signer rotation.

new_node_signature.description: ECDSA signature from the target node accepting signer responsibility.

guild_witness_signatures.description: M-of-N threshold signatures from authorized guild witness peers (mandatory for EMERGENCY_DISASTER_RECOVERY).

challenge_timelock_deadline.description: Mandatory challenge timelock deadline (e.g. 7-day quarantine window) protecting against malicious recovery attempts.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds recording migration manifest generation.
